items.title: Albanian police fire tear gas at 'Flamingo Revolution' rally
items.description: Albanians have continued to protest against a planned luxury resort backed by Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner. They say the resort threatens the coast's fragile ecosystems, including a flamingo habitat.

items.title: Billions unlocked as Green Climate Fund agrees to spend more and save less
items.description: The board of the UN's flagship climate fund has agreed to allowed management to invest more of its money in projects in developing nations and keep less in reserve The post Billions unlocked as Green Climate Fund agrees to spend more and save less appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: As food shocks spread, citizens are showing more leadership than governments
items.description: People support efforts to protect forests and curb industrial food production, the results of the latest Global Citizens' Assembly show - but politicians have been slow to act The post As food shocks spread, citizens are showing more leadership than governments appeared first on Climate Home News.

items.title: Tropical forest protection fund at risk after UK stalls on pledge
items.description: The Brazil-led TFFF was launched at COP30 as an innovative financial model to keep rainforests standing, but is still short on startup cash The post Tropical forest protection fund at risk after UK stalls on pledge appeared first on Climate Home News.
